summary: LUMI Messenger Feature Complete - ALL TESTS PASSED. Portal Selector shows 3 cards (MedMatch AI, AI KARAU, LUMI Messenger). LUMI login page renders correctly at /lumi with email/password form. Login works with admin@medmatch.com credentials. Channels sidebar shows all seeded channels. Channel selection, messaging, and create channel modal all function correctly. Navigation between LUMI and KARAU works via 'AI KARAU' button and 'Back to Portal' link.
seed_data_creation: Backend seed data includes 5 channels: General, Engineering, Design, Announcements, Random. Created via POST /api/lumi/seed
context_for_next_testing_agent: LUMI Messenger is fully functional. Backend APIs for channels and messages work correctly. Frontend UI includes login page, channel sidebar, message view, create channel modal. WebSocket endpoint exists for real-time messaging at /api/lumi/ws/{user_id}. Navigation between LUMI and KARAU works correctly.
